description: Mobile webview. Read-only fs access scoped to the only two sources a document can come from: the system picker (content:// URIs) and the app's managed imports store where open-with payloads are copied. On Android $APPDATA is the app's dataDir and MainActivity writes the copies to filesDir/imports, which is $APPDATA/files/imports; $APPDATA/imports stays for older layouts. A parser bug can therefore not read arbitrary app-private files over IPC. No write access, no network.
